newsitem.title: UK: Safeway leads sector up, SocGen says "buy".
newsitem.headline: Safeway leads sector up, SocGen says "buy".

text.p: Shares in supermarket group Safeway Plc led others in the sector higher on Wednesday, after analysts at SocGen said switch from J. Sainsbury Plc into Safeway, dealers said.
Shares in Safeway were up 9-1/2 to 384p and even Sainsbury was up 2p to 389 by 1010 GMT.
Elsewhere in the sector Tesco climbed 10-1/2p to 417p.
Traders said food retail stocks continued to benefit from a flight to safety after the budget, and as currency sensitive stocks were dogged by the prospect of further interest rate rises.

"This sector has shone as they have absolutely no problems with strong sterling and they are unaffected by the change in dividend tax," said one senior dealer. "News yesterday that inflation was picking up was also good for these stocks."
One market-maker noted U.S. buying in particular as investors increasingly turn away from overseas to domestic earners.
Analysts at BZW on Monday agreed that the food retail sector was less disadvantaged than most by the budget, adding that they preferred Safeway and Tesco in the long run.
